## Headings

!!! abstract "Instructions"
    **Using the editor below**, turn each line of text into a heading.

    - `Pet Grooming Guide` is the main heading of the page
    - `Bathing` and `Brushing` are section headings
    - `Short Hair` and `Long Hair` are sub-sections of `Brushing`

<embed src="/tools/code#eyJ0aXRsZSI6ICJFZGl0b3IiLCAicGFnZXMiOiBbeyJuYW1lIjogImluZGV4Lmh0bWwiLCAiaHRtbCI6ICJQZXQgR3Jvb21pbmcgR3VpZGVcblxuQmF0aGluZ1xuXG5CcnVzaGluZ1xuXG5TaG9ydCBIYWlyXG5cbkxvbmcgSGFpciJ9XSwgImNzcyI6ICIiLCAianMiOiAiIiwgImFjdGl2ZVRhYiI6ICJodG1sIiwgImFjdGl2ZVBhZ2UiOiAiaW5kZXguaHRtbCJ9"></embed>
??? question "Hint"
    There should only be one level 1 heading on a page. Each level down uses the next number, so the heading elements you need are `h1`, `h2` and `h3`. Do not skip a level.

## Paragraphs

!!! abstract "Instructions"
    **Using the editor below**, turn the text into **three** separate paragraphs. Each sentence should be its own paragraph.

<embed src="/tools/code#eyJ0aXRsZSI6ICJFZGl0b3IiLCAicGFnZXMiOiBbeyJuYW1lIjogImluZGV4Lmh0bWwiLCAiaHRtbCI6ICJPdXIgc2hvcCBvcGVuZWQgaW4gMjAxMi4gV2Ugc2VsbCBoYW5kLW1hZGUgZnVybml0dXJlLiBFdmVyeSBwaWVjZSBpcyBtYWRlIHRvIG9yZGVyLiJ9XSwgImNzcyI6ICIiLCAianMiOiAiIiwgImFjdGl2ZVRhYiI6ICJodG1sIiwgImFjdGl2ZVBhZ2UiOiAiaW5kZXguaHRtbCJ9"></embed>

    The tag name for the **paragraph** element is called `p`. Notice that pressing `Enter` in the code does not create a new line in the preview. Each sentence needs its own element.

## Headings and Paragraphs

!!! abstract "Instructions"
    **Using the editor below**, mark up this short page so that it has:

    - one main heading: `Riverside Bike Repairs`
    - a section heading: `Our Services`, followed by a paragraph
    - a section heading: `Contact Us`, followed by a paragraph

    The text is already in the editor. You only need to add the elements.

<embed src="/tools/code#"></embed>
??? question "Hint"
    Decide which heading level each line needs before you start: the site name is the most important heading on the page, and the two section headings share the same level below it. The sentences use the paragraph element.

## Important and Emphasised Text

!!! abstract "Instructions"
    **Using the editor below**:

    - mark the word `Warning:` as **important**
    - **emphasise** the word `never`

    Use the elements that carry meaning for screen readers, not `b` and `i`.

<embed src="/tools/code#"></embed>
??? question "Hint"
    The **important** element is called `strong` and the **emphasis** element is called `em`. They look the same as bold and italic, but also tell screen readers the words matter.

## Line Breaks

!!! abstract "Instructions"
    **Using the editor below**, make the address display on **three** lines, without creating three separate paragraphs.

<embed src="/tools/code#eyJ0aXRsZSI6ICJFZGl0b3IiLCAicGFnZXMiOiBbeyJuYW1lIjogImluZGV4Lmh0bWwiLCAiaHRtbCI6ICI8cD5cbiAgUml2ZXJzaWRlIEJpa2UgUmVwYWlyc1xuICAxNSBSaXZlciBSb2FkXG4gIEJlbmRpZ28gVklDIDM1NTBcbjwvcD4ifV0sICJjc3MiOiAiIiwgImpzIjogIiIsICJhY3RpdmVUYWIiOiAiaHRtbCIsICJhY3RpdmVQYWdlIjogImluZGV4Lmh0bWwifQ=="></embed>
??? question "Hint"
    The **line break** element is called `br`. It is an empty element, so it has no closing tag. Think about where the break needs to go: at the end of each line, except the last.

## Horizontal Rules

!!! abstract "Instructions"
    **Using the editor below**, add a **horizontal rule** between the two sections so they are visually separated.

<embed src="/tools/code#"></embed>
??? question "Hint"
    The **horizontal rule** element is called `hr`. Like `br`, it has no closing tag. It goes after the last paragraph of the first section and before the next heading.

## Comments

!!! abstract "Instructions"
    **Using the editor below**, add an HTML **comment** above each section describing what the section is for, for example `Services section`.

    Check the preview: your comments should **not** appear on the page.

<embed src="/tools/code#"></embed>
??? question "Hint"
    A comment starts with a less-than sign, an exclamation mark and two hyphens, and ends with two hyphens and a greater-than sign. The [Elements](../resources/elements.md#comments) resource shows the format.

## Fix the Broken Elements

!!! abstract "Instructions"
    **Using the editor below**, find and fix the **four** mistakes in the code so that every element is written correctly.

<embed src="/tools/code#"></embed>
??? question "Hint"
    Check every element one at a time. Does each opening tag have a closing tag? Does each closing tag have a forward slash? Does the closing tag have the same name as its opening tag? Is every tag finished with a greater-than sign?
